missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Берег' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Тихим' and 'пустым' are instrumental predicate adjectives after past 'был'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Берег' is the accusative direct object of 'искали'; for this inanimate masculine noun, the accusative matches the nominative. 'Высокий' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Берега' is the genitive form after 'у', showing nearness. 'Самого' emphasises the very edge.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Берегу' is the dative form after 'к', expressing movement toward the shore. 'Медленно' describes the pace.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Берегом' is the instrumental governed by 'любовались'. 'Крутым' agrees with it, and 'реки' is genitive showing whose shore.

missions.phrase: Дети играют на берегу весь день.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Locative prepositional. 'На берегу' uses the special locative ending '-у' after 'на' to express location. 'Весь день' adds duration.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Берега' is the genitive after 'от', showing movement away. 'Утром' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a number word. After 'оба', the noun takes the form 'берега'. The predicate 'крутые' refers to both banks.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Берега' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'тянулись'. 'Зелёные' agrees in the plural, and 'вдоль реки' sets the path.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Берег' is the accusative after 'на' with motion, marking the destination of 'вышли'. 'Песчаный' agrees with it.
